meta.title: About Brisk — A digital agency from Belgium
meta.description: Brisk designs and builds custom websites, webshops, software and mobile apps. You talk directly to the people who build it. 17 live websites, 50+ product screens, a reply within 24 hours.

hero.lead: Brisk is a digital agency based in Belgium. We design and build custom websites, webshops, software and mobile apps. You talk directly to the people who build it, from the first call until long after launch.

p1.rest: No themes, no page builders, no plugin that almost does what you need. Every project starts with your customer and ends in code of our own, designed around the way you work.

p2.rest: If an idea will not work, you hear it in the first call, not on the invoice. You get honest advice, even when it means you need less than you thought.

p3.rest: Short phases, and a working version you can use before the last pixel is in place. And everything we make is yours: design, code and data.

principles.title: Five things we never let go.

one.title: Understand first, then build.
one.body: Every project starts with questions, not a quote. What does your customer need to do, and what is stopping them today.

two.title: Speed is a feature.
two.body: A slow site loses customers. Every page we build is measured before it goes live, on a real phone.

three.title: Detail is not polish.
three.body: The transitions, the error message, the empty screen. The last five percent decides how something feels.

four.title: No noise.
four.body: One message per screen, one accent. Anything that does not help you understand or decide gets cut.

five.title: Yours, not ours.
five.body: Design, code and data belong to you. You can always carry on without us, although we hope you will not want to.

how.title: What a project with Brisk looks like.

contact.title: Direct contact
contact.body: You talk to the people who build it. No account manager in between, no brief that gets passed on three times.

price.title: Fixed price per phase
price.body: Every phase has a clear scope and a price agreed up front. You know what you are getting before you say yes.

custom.title: Custom, always
custom.body: No templates, no themes. Every screen is designed for your customer and built in code we write ourselves.
